task1: A WSI of Colorectal Cancer with no RAS/BRAF mutation at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of well to moderately formed tubular glandular architectures, infiltrative tumor margins extending irregularly into the stroma, and a prominent desmoplastic stromal reaction with scattered areas of luminal necrotic debris.
task2: A WSI of Microsatellite Stable Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of complex, irregularly shaped glandular structures invading the bowel wall, extensive regions of luminal dirty necrosis, and a dense, fibrous desmoplastic stroma lacking significant peritumoral lymphoid aggregates.

task1: A WSI of Colorectal Cancer with RAS/BRAF mutation at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of prominent mucinous differentiation characterized by large extracellular mucin pools, frequent serrated or cribriform glandular growth patterns, and expansile or pushing tumor margins with variable stromal cellularity.
task2: A WSI of MSI-H Colorectal Cancer at low resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of solid or medullary tumor growth patterns lacking well-defined glands, distinct pushing tumor margins, and a prominent peritumoral Crohn's-like lymphoid reaction featuring conspicuous lymphoid follicles with germinal centers.

task1: A WSI of Colorectal Cancer with no RAS/BRAF mutation at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of pseudostratified columnar tumor cells with elongated hyperchromatic nuclei, distinct cell borders with apical mucin depletion, and prominent intraluminal granular necrotic debris (dirty necrosis) within the glandular structures.
task2: A WSI of Microsatellite Stable Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of closely packed, irregular glands lined by pleomorphic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitotic figures, distinct nuclear molding, and a notable absence of prominent intraepithelial lymphocytes.

task1: A WSI of Colorectal Cancer with RAS/BRAF mutation at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of atypical epithelial cells frequently floating in abundant extracellular mucin, vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli, loss of normal glandular architecture, and occasional presence of focal signet-ring cell morphology.
task2: A WSI of MSI-H Colorectal Cancer at high resolution with visually descriptive characteristics of poorly differentiated tumor cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli arranged in solid sheets, heavily interspersed with numerous tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs), and variable focal regions of mucinous differentiation.
